value.tagline: The Fifth Republic - a semi-presidential power where a directly-elected President governs with a Prime Minister and a bicameral Parliament.
value.descriptor: A semi-presidential republic: a directly-elected President leads alongside a Prime Minister answerable to the 491-seat National Assembly, with an indirectly-elected Senate.

upperChamber.name: Council of the Republic
upperChamber.description: 320 councillors of the Conseil de la République, elected indirectly by local authorities for six-year terms. A weaker revising chamber under the Fourth Republic.

lowerChamber.name: National Assembly
lowerChamber.description: 627 deputies elected in the June 1951 election by proportional representation. The chamber that made and unmade Fourth Republic cabinets.
